<div id="shash-shape" class="normal-demo">

<div class="normal-top">

<div class="normal-controls">

<label class="normal-control">
<span>Mean</span>
<input
  data-param="location"
  type="range"
  min="-2"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="0">
<span data-value="location"></span>
</label>

<label class="normal-control">
<span>SD</span>
<input
  data-param="scale"
  type="range"
  min="0.3"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="1">
<span data-value="scale"></span>
</label>

<label class="normal-control">
<span>Skewness</span>
<input
  data-param="skew"
  type="range"
  min="-2"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="0">
<span data-value="skew"></span>
</label>

<label class="normal-control">
<span>Kurtosis</span>
<input
  data-param="tail"
  type="range"
  min="0.4"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="1">
<span data-value="tail"></span>
</label>

</div>

</div>

<svg></svg>

</div>

<script>
shashDemo("#shash-shape", {
  xmin: -6,
  xmax: 6,
  ymax: 1.2,
  height: 300
});
</script>
